timing.clock_basis: host monotonic receipt and board counters reported separately

acknowledgements.basis: first exact last_seq receipt relative to the host write interval
acknowledgements.limitations: Receipt-domain bounds only; not physical actuation, board acceptance time, one-way latency, or sensor age. Unobserved sequences may reflect telemetry or log loss; later sequences do not prove a skipped command was accepted.

campaigns.comparison_clock: camera host-read vs encoder host-receipt, both Jetson monotonic; uncalibrated exposure/serial latency; no fitted alignment
campaigns.low_rate_selection: abs recorded omega < 0.15 rad/s; may include turning points, not a physical-rest assertion
campaigns.comparison_reference: Camera hanging zero and saved encoder upright330 differ; disagreements are not physical sensor accuracy. Camera 2pi branch chosen nearest encoder only for plotting.
